newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PRIVATISATION AGENCY PUTS KIVITER ON SALE.
newsitem.headline: PRIVATISATION AGENCY PUTS KIVITER ON SALE.

text.p: The privatisation agency on Wednesday announced the sale of 100 percent of the shares of chemical factory RAS Kiviter.
"People who are interested can submit their bids and when we have a suitable bid we will begin negotiations," a privatisation agency official said.
The company's turnover in 1996 was 844.6 million kroons and the plant is situated in Kohtla-Jarve in north-eastern Estonia.
Bids are to include the purchase price, proposed investment, and a business plan including environmental protection measures.
An earlier sale attempt in March failed beause the parties could not agree on environment protection and the price of oil shale, the main raw material for the plant.
Kiviter also includes a water treatment plant for the nearby town of Kohtla-Jarve. Negotiations with the town over the plant are underway, the agency added.
